name: Instagram
description: Post photos, videos, stories, and manage Instagram Business content.

properties.name: imageUrl
properties.description: Public URL of the image to post

properties.name: videoUrl
properties.description: Public URL of the video to post

properties.name: location
properties.description: Facebook Page ID to tag as location

executionCode: try { helpers.log('Starting Instagram node execution'); const accessToken = node.properties.credential?.value; const accountId = node.properties.accountId?.value; const operation = node.properties.operation?.value; if (!accessToken) { helpers.error('Access token is missing'); throw new Error('Instagram Graph API access token is required'); } if (!operation) { helpers.error('Operation is missing'); throw new Error('Operation is required'); } const doFetch = async (url, opts) => { const res = await fetch(url, opts); const json = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) { const msg = json?.error?.message || JSON.stringify(json); throw new Error(msg); } return json; }; if (operation === 'createPost') { const mediaType = node.properties.mediaType?.value || 'IMAGE'; const caption = node.properties.caption?.value || ''; if (!accountId) throw new Error('Instagram Business Account ID is required'); const containerEndpoint = `https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0/${accountId}/media`; const containerBody = (mediaType === 'IMAGE') ? { image_url: node.properties.imageUrl?.value, caption } : { video_url: node.properties.videoUrl?.value, media_type: 'VIDEO', caption }; if (!containerBody.image_url && mediaType==='IMAGE') throw new Error('Image URL is required for image posts'); if (!containerBody.video_url && mediaType==='VIDEO') throw new Error('Video URL is required for video posts'); const container = await doFetch(`${containerEndpoint}?access_token=${accessToken}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(containerBody) }); const publishEndpoint = `https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0/${accountId}/media_publish`; const publish = await doFetch(`${publishEndpoint}?access_token=${accessToken}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ creation_id: container.id }) }); return { ...data, instagram: publish }; } else if (operation === 'createStory') { if (!accountId) throw new Error('Instagram Business Account ID is required'); const imageUrl = node.properties.imageUrl?.value; if (!imageUrl) throw new Error('Image URL is required for stories'); const storyEndpoint = `https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0/${accountId}/media`; const container = await doFetch(`${storyEndpoint}?access_token=${accessToken}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ image_url: imageUrl, media_type: 'STORIES' }) }); const publishEndpoint = `https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0/${accountId}/media_publish`; const publish = await doFetch(`${publishEndpoint}?access_token=${accessToken}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ creation_id: container.id }) }); return { ...data, instagram: publish }; } else if (operation === 'createReel') { if (!accountId) throw new Error('Instagram Business Account ID is required'); const videoUrl = node.properties.videoUrl?.value; const caption = node.properties.caption?.value || ''; if (!videoUrl) throw new Error('Video URL is required for reels'); const reelEndpoint = `https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0/${accountId}/media`; const container = await doFetch(`${reelEndpoint}?access_token=${accessToken}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ video_url: videoUrl, media_type: 'REELS', caption }) }); const publishEndpoint = `https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0/${accountId}/media_publish`; const publish = await doFetch(`${publishEndpoint}?access_token=${accessToken}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ creation_id: container.id }) }); return { ...data, instagram: publish }; } else if (operation === 'getMediaInsights') { const mediaId = node.properties.mediaId?.value; const metrics = node.properties.metrics?.value || 'engagement,impressions,reach'; if (!mediaId) throw new Error('Media ID is required for insights'); const endpoint = `https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0/${mediaId}/insights?metric=${metrics}&access_token=${accessToken}`; const result = await doFetch(endpoint, { method: 'GET' }); return { ...data, instagram: result }; } else if (operation === 'getAccountInsights') { if (!accountId) throw new Error('Instagram Business Account ID is required'); const metrics = node.properties.metrics?.value || 'impressions,reach,profile_views'; const endpoint = `https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0/${accountId}/insights?metric=${metrics}&period=day&access_token=${accessToken}`; const result = await doFetch(endpoint, { method: 'GET' }); return { ...data, instagram: result }; } else { throw new Error(`Unsupported operation: ${operation}`); } } catch (error) { helpers.error('Instagram node execution failed:', error.message); return { path: 'error', data: { error: error.message } }; }
